display_name: The whole Child Development Co-Savings Act 2001 (Parts 1-4, First and Second Schedules) under one top-level goal — what paid leave or Government payment a parent gets for a child, capped how, and what the employer may claim back — and eight goals: common measures, the Co-Savings Scheme, maternity, adoption, fathers, shared parental leave, childcare leave, recovery and offences
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 07 Oct 2026 (2020 Revised Edition, amended to Act 46 of 2024 in force 1 April 2025). The Act's own date cohorts (April 2025 and January 2024 Scheme children, the 2017, 2021 and 2025 gates, Second Schedule para 5) are encoded as printed. Inputs: pay or lost income per week, total income per day in the prescribed period, Employment Act 1968 periods, regulations, discretions. Carried as text: powers, procedure and the limbs listed in each module's 'carried as text'. NOT encoded: nothing in the Act.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-07 (tests-independent.l4; 163 expectations written from the source before the encoding was read): 267 of 268 assertions satisfied, none failed, one refuses by design (fork F9); a probe found the goal withheld the Government-paid benefit from a parent with no current employer, fixed; triage in INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md and NOTES.md section 4. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: The first 8 (adoption: 4) weeks are paid at gross, uncapped and not reimbursed, for a first or second event.
forks.F2: s 9(1A): 'within the first 4 [8] weeks of the specified period' is before its start plus 28 [56] days.
forks.F3: s 9(1A)(iva): the 16 weeks run 112 days from the first day of absence.
forks.F4: ss 12H(4), 12I(4): the self-employed father's cohort is January 2024, as printed (employees: April 2025).
forks.F5: Second Schedule para 5: a birth on 31 March 2026 with an April 2026 estimated delivery date has M = 10.
forks.F6: s 12E(7): weeks given up come off the capped (reimbursed) weeks first.
forks.F7: s 12B(2)(a): per-child remainders first, then the 6-day combined cap.
forks.F8: The top-level goal refuses a child who became a citizen after birth, naming the s 9(1A)/(1B) rules.
forks.F9: s 3(3): the co-savings match refuses without the regulations' cap.

checks.result: 10 modules: 0 errors, 490 assertions satisfied, 0 failed (223 encoder, 267 independent); 1 independent assertion refuses by design (F9), which check.sh does not count
